name: io.github.ohneben/learnworlds-mcp
description: LearnWorlds MCP server — all 94 API endpoints as safety-categorized tools (Docker + Streamable HTTP).

environment_variables.name: LEARNWORLDS_BASE_URL
environment_variables.description: Base URL of your LearnWorlds school's API, e.g. https://<your-school>.learnworlds.com/admin/api

environment_variables.name: LEARNWORLDS_API_TOKEN
environment_variables.description: Bearer access token (LearnWorlds admin -> Settings -> Integrations -> Developers).

environment_variables.name: LEARNWORLDS_CLIENT_ID
environment_variables.description: Your school's Client ID, sent as the Lw-Client header.

environment_variables.name: MCP_SHARED_TOKEN
environment_variables.description: Optional bearer token required on the /mcp endpoint. Empty = open (localhost only).
